author: Andrew Aronoff
text: Much too complicated! I apply the new sensor after I shower. I cover the sensor with a smith&nephew IV3000 2 3/8 x 2 3/4 adhesive. That’s it. No lotions, potions or notions. No waiting, either. My sensors last the full 14 days.

author: Steve Kuckuk
text: I scrub the site with a coarse kitchen scrubbing sponge, air dry, then alcohol wipe, again air dry (if necessary shave any arm hair first) . . . When applying the sensor I push with one quick, firm action, holding the push tor a long count of at least 10 before pulling the applicator away from the newly attached sensor . . . I want the surface of skin to be completely clean and sort of rough so the adhesive on the sensor works . . . After attached I use "Skin Grip Adhesive Patches for Freestyle Libre 3" from Amazon . . . About $25.00 for twenty patches . . . For me it lasts the full two weeks and in several years of use I’ve never had one fail or even misbehave.
